lead: `mysql_common`'s `Column` serializes `column_length` and `character_set` in the opposite order to its own deserializer.
body: The reader matches the wire; only a case asking about the charset or width notices — `rule:core-classes/db-column-types` reads `tainted string` against `tainted bytes` off the charset. Write the definition bytes by hand in wire order (`typed_column_def` in `crates/nvs-db/src/mysql.rs`), never through `MySerialize`.
